character: A tall long-armed woman of forty, dark brown wings folded high behind her shoulders, flour on the wingtips, close-cropped black hair, a broad easy smile.
wardrobe: A loose sleeveless shirt, a striped apron, bare forearms with old oven burns.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing at the edge of a floating rock island beside a row of café tables, open sky and clouds behind her.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Carrying a tray of fruit along a row of tables at the very edge of a floating island, hammocks slung out over the open drop, far below a sea of clouds.
